info.name: Wolfram|Alpha Fast Query Recognizer Classification Queries API
Wolfram|Alpha Submit a Full Results Query

params.name: appid
params.description: Wolfram|Alpha AppID for authentication.

params.name: input
params.description: URL-encoded natural language query string.

params.name: output
params.description: Response format. Use json for JSON output; default is XML.

params.name: format
params.description: Comma-separated list of content formats to include in results: image, plaintext, mathml, minput, moutput, cell, sound, wav.

params.name: includepodid
params.description: Include only pods with these IDs (comma-separated).

params.name: excludepodid
params.description: Exclude pods with these IDs (comma-separated).

params.name: podtitle
params.description: Include only pods whose title matches this pattern.

params.name: podindex
params.description: Include only pods at these ordinal positions (comma-separated).

params.name: scanner
params.description: Include only pods generated by specific scanners.

params.name: async
params.description: Use asynchronous delivery for long-running computations.

params.name: location
params.description: Location name for geographically relevant results.

params.name: latlong
params.description: Latitude and longitude for location-aware results.

params.name: ip
params.description: IP address for location detection.

params.name: units
params.description: Measurement system. Values are metric or imperial.

params.name: width
params.description: Width in pixels for image results. Default is 500.

params.name: maxwidth
params.description: Maximum width in pixels for images.

params.name: mag
params.description: Magnification factor for images.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Maximum processing time in seconds. Default is 5.

params.name: assumption
params.description: Assumption values to refine query interpretation.

items.docs: Submit a free-form natural language query to the Wolfram|Alpha Full Results API. Returns results in XML (default) or JSON with complete pod data, disambiguations, drilldowns, assumptions, and formatted mathematical/scientific output. Supports asynchronous delivery for long-running computations.

params.name: appid
params.description: The Wolfram|Alpha AppID used for authentication. Obtain from the Wolfram|Alpha Developer Portal.

params.name: input
params.value: What is the boiling point of water?
params.description: URL-encoded natural language query string.

params.name: maxchars
params.description: Maximum number of characters in the response. Default is 6800.

params.name: assumption
params.description: Assumption values to refine query interpretation.

params.name: ip
params.description: IP address of the query origin for location-aware results.

params.name: latlong
params.description: Latitude and longitude for location-based queries (e.g., 40.71,-74.00).

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone name for the query context.

params.name: units
params.description: Measurement system preference. Values are metric or imperial.

params.name: currency
params.description: ISO 4217 currency code for financial queries.

params.name: languagecode
params.description: BCP 47 language code for query input and response.

params.name: formattimeout
params.description: Maximum processing time in seconds before timeout.

items.docs: Submit a natural language query to the Wolfram|Alpha LLM API. Returns structured text with query interpretation, computed results, relevant data, and a link to the full Wolfram|Alpha results page. Optimized for consumption by large language models and AI chat applications.

params.name: appid
params.description: Wolfram|Alpha AppID for authentication.

params.name: i
params.value: How far is the Moon from Earth?
params.description: URL-encoded input query string.

params.name: units
params.description: Measurement system preference. Values are metric or imperial.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Maximum processing time in seconds. Default is 5.

items.docs: Submit a natural language query and receive a single concise plain-text answer. Suitable for chatbots, voice assistants, and constrained display contexts. Returns HTTP 501 when the query has no short answer.

params.name: appid
params.description: Wolfram|Alpha AppID for authentication.

params.name: i
params.description: URL-encoded input query string.

params.name: layout
params.description: Content presentation style. Values are divider (default) or labelbar.

params.name: background
params.description: Image background color as HTML color name, hex value, or RGB value.

params.name: foreground
params.description: Text color. Values are black (default) or white.

params.name: fontsize
params.description: Font size in points for rendered text. Default is 14.

params.name: width
params.description: Image width in pixels. Default is 500.

params.name: units
params.description: Measurement system preference. Values are metric or imperial.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Maximum processing time in seconds. Default is 5.

items.docs: Submit a natural language query and receive the complete Wolfram|Alpha result rendered as a static image. Customizable background, foreground, font size, and width. Does not support disambiguation, drilldown, or asynchronous delivery.

items.docs: Submit a natural language query and receive a plain-text answer formatted for audio delivery. Results are phrased naturally for text-to-speech conversion, suitable for voice assistants, automotive applications, and accessibility features.
